item.title: Q&A: Hendrickson gears up for new CEO role with Adolfson & Peterson
item.description: Adolfson & Peterson names Brad Hendrickson CEO as Jeff Hansen retires, capping record growth and $1.5B in revenue for the 80-year-old firm.

item.title: Where does City Center go from here?
item.description: The City Center office tower in downtown Minneapolis prepares for sale and potential redevelopment.

item.title: Soaring oil prices intensify U.S. affordability concerns
item.description: Oil prices surge after Iran conflict disrupts Strait of Hormuz shipping, raising risks of $4 gas and renewed inflation pressure in the U.S.

item.title: U.S. manufacturing expands steadily as input prices surge
item.description: U.S. manufacturing PMI held at 52.4 in February, while factory input prices hit a 3.5-year high amid tariffs and rising oil prices after Iran strikes.

item.title: Trump allies warm to solar amid AI-driven power demands
item.description: Trump allies including Katie Miller and Elon Musk promote solar as AI-driven electricity demand surges, signaling a shift in MAGA energy policy.

item.title: Construction begins on long-delayed Green Bay apartments
item.description: Construction begins on One Astor Park, a $21M, 128-unit apartment project along the Fox River in Green Bay, with rooftop patio and riverfront amenities.

item.title: Sustainable: AI startup guides homeowners to cut carbon, costs
item.description: St. Paul startup Green Home Club uses AI to guide Minnesota homeowners on energy upgrades, cutting carbon emissions, costs, and boosting efficiency.

item.title: Fed closely monitoring AI’s impact on jobs, inflation
item.description: Federal Reserve officials are divided on AI’s effect on the labor market, productivity, and inflation, shaping future monetary policy debates.

item.title: Woodbury reviews 184-acre Bailey Nurseries redevelopment
item.description: Woodbury is reviewing plans to redevelop the 184-acre Bailey Nurseries site with up to 360 housing units, business park space and new retail.

item.title: Three Twin Cities metro senior living properties sold
item.description: Senior living properties in Rosemount, Bloomington and St. Paul sold for a combined $65.1 million amid continued investor demand in the sector.
